description: This file defines the 'Maximum' class, which provides static methods for calculating maximum values in datasets, including standard maximum (MAX) and extended maximum that includes text and logical values (MAXA). It is part of the PHPSpreadsheet library under the Calculation\Statistical namespace.

classes.name: Maximum
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate maximum values within datasets, handling errors and different data types.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Calculates the maximum numeric value from a list of arguments, returning 0 if no numeric values are found.

methods.name: maxA
methods.description: Calculates the maximum value considering numbers, text, and logical values, including non-numeric data, returning 0 if no valid data is found.
